rules: Region changes are explicit Owner actions using a coarse region code.
Regional transition inventory rows must belong to the exact Owner requesting the transition.
Switching region never grants World resources.
Switching region never removes or expires an owned item.
Owned items from another regional collection remain in inventory but are not auto-placed into the active region.
Unknown and retired owned item ids remain retained until an explicit migration policy exists.
Exact location, geofencing and passive movement do not trigger regional transitions.
